_readme: Client results data. This file is the ONE place revenue figures live: the homepage total and each portfolio case study's results strip are both built from it by assets/js/results.js. To show a client's revenue, set `revenue` to a number (their annual revenue in CAD; if the client gave a range, use its lower bound, because it is displayed as '$X+'). Leave it null to show nothing. Only add a figure the client has agreed to have displayed. `id` must match data-client-results in portfolio.html; `project` is the line shown under 'Project'.
